response.question_summary: H = R → tan θ = 4 → (B), key correct.

reports.evidence: u²sin²θ/2g = u²(2 sinθ cosθ)/g → tan θ = 4 (both blind solves); tan⁻¹ 2 comes from dropping the 2 in sin 2θ = 2 sinθ cosθ.
reports.student_reply: You were nearly there! Setting H = R gives sin²θ/2 = 2 sinθ cosθ, so tan θ = 4 - getting 2 usually means the 2 in sin 2θ = 2 sinθ cosθ got dropped. So (B) tan⁻¹ 4 is correct.
